all positive non-eventually-periodic shortcut orbits for P126, P127, P129, and P131
all positive finite source-prefix powers for P130, with a local source required away from time zero
positive rational noncyclic shortcut orbits only under EXT08 for P128

all direct orbits and all covered repeats from literal states using an independent bit-reversal implementation

stop_conditions: Keep state equality and eventual-periodic parity tails outside every nonperiodic theorem.
Do not treat formal NG22, P109, or A/B words as positive ordinary-source orbits.
Do not promote a Q<=17 exclusion proportion or 512-bit profile to an eventual theorem.
Do not replace EXT08 liminf density by a natural-density assertion.
Require a P115 lift or another ordinary-integrality mechanism before claiming progress that closes H112.
Enter the proof-claim emergency protocol before changing proves_collatz.
interpretation_boundary: The unconditional linear factor-complexity barrier excludes low-complexity parity words of positive nonperiodic integer orbits but supplies no orbit-height upper bound.
The H89 repetition rule is a finite rejection certificate, not an eventual H89 theorem.
H89, H112, H72, the nontrivial-cycle branch, and Collatz remain open; proves_collatz remains false.
